intro: 12 個辦公程序情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: In appreciation of your hard work, the department will hold a lunch party on November third.
ex.zh: 為感謝你的辛勤工作,部門將於十一月三日舉辦午餐聚會。

ex.en: Your appreciation of my efforts inspired me through the final stages of the construction.
ex.zh: 你對我努力的肯定,激勵我走過工程的最後階段。

note: in appreciation of sth 為感謝⋯;show appreciation 表達謝意
appreciate 感謝、賞識;appreciative 感激的

ex.en: The company president wanted to bring in an efficiency consultant.
ex.zh: 公司總裁想要引進一位效率顧問。

ex.en: The company brought in a new team of project planners.
ex.zh: 公司引進了一支新的專案企劃團隊。

note: 可分離片語:bring him in,代名詞須放中間
亦指「造成⋯出現」,to cause to appear

ex.en: On Fridays, most employees dress casually.
ex.zh: 每逢星期五,多數員工穿著休閒。

ex.en: Martin spoke casually, as if he were chatting with friends.
ex.zh: 馬丁說話很隨性,彷彿在和朋友聊天。

note: casual 非正式的、隨意的;casualness 隨意
dress casually 穿著休閒;business casual 商務休閒

ex.en: The new employees observed the unwritten code of conduct in their first week on the job.
ex.zh: 新進員工在上班第一週就察覺到了那套不成文的行為準則。

ex.en: Even the most traditional companies are changing their dress code to something less formal.
ex.zh: 就連最傳統的公司,也在把服裝規定改得比較不正式。

note: code of conduct 行為準則;dress code 服裝規定

ex.en: Mergers require that employees be exposed to different business practices.
ex.zh: 併購要求員工接觸不同的商業做法。

ex.en: The new hires' week in each department exposed them to the various functions in the company.
ex.zh: 新進人員在各部門各待一週,讓他們接觸到公司的各種職能。

note: be exposed to sth 接觸到⋯,多用被動
exposure 接觸、曝光;exposed 暴露的

ex.en: I haven't met the new client yet, but I caught a glimpse of her as she was leaving the office.
ex.zh: 我還沒見過新客戶,但她離開辦公室時我瞥見了一眼。

ex.en: After one year with the company, he still felt he had only a glimpse of the overall operations.
ex.zh: 在公司待了一年後,他仍覺得自己只對整體營運略窺一二。

note: catch / get a glimpse of sth 瞥見⋯
glimpse 是無意瞥見;glance 是刻意快速看一眼

ex.en: This job will really test what you are made of.
ex.zh: 這份工作真能考驗出你是什麼料。

ex.en: People say that the negotiator has nerves made of steel.
ex.zh: 人們說那位談判者有著鋼鐵般的膽識。

note: made of 看得出原料;made from 原料已變形
what sb is made of 某人的本事、能耐

ex.en: Orders should be placed before you run out of the supplies.
ex.zh: 應該在用品用完之前就先下訂單。

ex.en: The presenter ran out of time before he reached his conclusion.
ex.zh: 簡報者在講到結論前就沒時間了。

note: run out of sth 用完⋯;out of stock 缺貨
後必須接名詞,不可單獨使用

ex.en: The purpose of the seminar is to have employees identify outdated methods and procedures.
ex.zh: 這場研討會的目的,是讓員工找出過時的方法與程序。

ex.en: Before you do a mailing, make sure that none of the addresses is outdated.
ex.zh: 寄送郵件前,請確認沒有任何地址已經過時。

note: outdate 使過時;反義 up-to-date 最新的

ex.en: The manager started her practice of weekly breakfast meetings more than twenty years ago.
ex.zh: 這位經理早在二十多年前就開始了每週早餐會報的做法。

ex.en: Bill practiced answering the office telephone until he felt he could do it right.
ex.zh: 比爾反覆練習接辦公室電話,直到他覺得能接得好為止。

note: make a practice of V-ing 養成⋯的習慣
美式動詞 practice;英式名詞 practice、動詞 practise

ex.en: The financial officer's unconventional method of analyzing data was reinforced by the business journal article.
ex.zh: 那位財務主管非傳統的資料分析方法,因這篇商業期刊文章而更具說服力。

ex.en: Employees reinforced their learning with practice in the workplace.
ex.zh: 員工透過職場上的實作來強化所學。

ex.en: She verbally reprimanded the new hire in front of his entire team.
ex.zh: 她當著整個團隊的面口頭斥責那位新進員工。

ex.en: The guarantee was made only verbally.
ex.zh: 這項保證只是口頭上的。

note: verbally 可指「口頭」或「用言語」;in writing 才是書面
verbal 口頭的、言語的;非 verbal 的相對是 written
